page.layout: One column of index entries from the top of the page to the lower part, with a running title at the head. Below the entries on the right is a dingbat ornament. Faint show-through in the middle of the page is not transcribed.; Running head at top, cut at the left edge; below it one column of index entries, with the letter Z set on its own line and the entries after it. Faint show-through in the middle of the column is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Vulsus non habet appellatio-nem Græcam Ciceroni. 102.

page.notes: Several numerals in the first lines are faint and uncertain: "2r" (line 1) may be "21", and "alba. 267" and "30" may be misread; these are not marked inline. "Vtrem" (last line) may be "Vtrum". The show-through in the middle of the page is not transcribed. The running head is cut at the left edge, so it is a fragment and is kept as printed. The Greek word in the second entry is only partly legible and is marked illegible. A small stray mark ("-3" or "~3") sits below the third entry and is not transcribed. The last reference may be "50" or "so" and is marked [?]. The large Z is joined to the first word of its entry. A printer's ornament sits at the lower left and is not text. Faint mid-column marks are show-through and are left out.
